title: Find the full names of members who attended the 'Laugh Out Loud' event and
question: Find the full names of members who attended the 'Laugh Out Loud' event and whose total approved expenses across all events exceed the average expense amount for the 'Parking' category.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_011 = 'Laugh Out Loud'
  AND (SELECT SUM(e2.XCL_020) FROM expense AS e2 WHERE e2.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034 AND e2.XCL_021 = 'true')
      > (SELECT AVG(e3.XCL_020) FROM expense AS e3 WHERE e3.XCL_018 = 'Parking')

FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002

  AND (SELECT SUM(e2.XCL_020) FROM expense e2 WHERE e2.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034 AND e2.XCL_021 = 'true')
